skills.description: Chinese fortune telling (算命 / 算卦 / 看八字 / 排盘) grounded in classical source texts: a bundled rule engine computes the chart, then the agent interprets it with an explicit school declaration. Computes BaZi Four Pillars (八字 / 四柱) with true-solar-time and 1986–1991 China DST correction via scripts/cantian (buildBaziFromSolar.ts, convertToTrueSolarTime.ts), pattern and useful-god analysis via the bundled BaZi analysis engine, and Zi Wei Dou Shu palaces and four transformations via the bundled Zi Wei Dou Shu engine. Also covers Liu Yao (六爻 / 起卦), Mei Hua Yi Shu (梅花易数), Qi Men Dun Jia (奇门遁甲), Da Liu Ren (大六壬), Qi Zheng Si Yu (七政四余), classical Western astrology, and date selection (择吉 / 择日 / 黄道吉日).
